extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology from article NXML/PDF text and figure captions; mechanism is bounded to membrane perturbation/necrotic death evidence and no molecular binding target is claimed.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Dec-NH2 treatment is associated with membrane disruption and necrotic cell death in MCF-7 cells.
source_observations: Flow cytometry assigned Annexin V+/PI+ cells to necrosis and showed higher necrotic fraction at 50 µmol L−1 Dec-NH2 after 24 h.
AFM showed increased MCF-7 membrane roughness after 24 h with 50 µmol L−1 Dec-NH2 compared with untreated cells and [Leu]8-Dec-NH2 control.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct death-mode and membrane-topology assays were performed for Dec-NH2; the record does not claim a specific molecular receptor or universal mechanism for every analog.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Hydrophobicity, amphipathicity, and net positive charge correlate with antitumoral activity in this analog series, but this is a structure-activity interpretation rather than a direct molecular mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Correlation is bounded to the tested peptides and source assays; no binding target or clinical efficacy claim is inferred.
